v1.3.2c (20 September 2022) |feed_title = Version 1.3.2 |previous_update = [[v1.3.1|End of Summer Update]] |next_update = [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.3.2''' is the forty-second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 2nd of August 2022. It introduced the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Minigunner]] skin and the [[Ruby Escort]] map. This version encompassed four updates, the main v1.3.2 update (released 2 September 2022) and three minor updates, the v1.3.2a update (released 9 September 2022), v1.3.2b update (released 19 September 2022) and v1.3.2c update (released 20 September 2022). ==Additions== *[[Ruby Escort]] (Survival) *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[Minigunner Plush]] **Code is unique for each [[Minigunner Plush]] bought **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Minigunner]] & [[Golden Minigunner]] skin :In '''v1.3.2a''': *New [[Codes|code]]: JOHNRETURNS **Gives {{Color|Other|John}} [[Militant]] skin :In '''v1.3.2b''': *[[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Fixed gamepass prices being cut off in the lobby. *Fixed [[Engineer]] sometimes not dealing damage. :In '''v1.3.2b''': *All maps have the [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier enabled to celebrate the International Talk Like a Pirate Day. :In '''v1.3.2c''': *[[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier is now disabled on all maps. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FZWG6bjXgAAK8 Y.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} File:ESummoner.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlushieMiniPI.jpg JohnSkinPI.jpg }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log.
